package.name: meridian_preprocess
package.description: L1 per-sensor preprocessing: LiDAR validity gate + decimation, stationary IMU init (gravity/gyro-bias) and IMU-only cold-start deskew, GNSS quality + spoof gate with LLA-to-ENU, and camera debayer/photometric/pyramid. Outputs undeskewed validated scans; deskew against the trajectory belongs to L2. No ROS.
